newsitem.title: INDIA: India call money market quiet on reporting Friday.
newsitem.headline: India call money market quiet on reporting Friday.

text.p: *Indian call money market was quiet on Friday, the bank's reporting day, dealers said.
Some banks were quoting 0.10-0.25 percent but there were no deals yet, one dealer said. A primary dealer said his institution was quoting 0.25-0.50 percent.
"It is a lenders' market with hardly any borrowers today," said a dealer. Most dealers expect call rates to open around 10 percent on Saturday, the first day of the new fortnight.
